answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, and let its transaction quota grow only from completed, peer-verified work. A new identity starts with almost no quota, so splitting one bond across many fake identities leaves each too weak to matter, while concentrating it in one identity risks the whole bond if it cheats. Misbehaviour slashes the bond and resets earned history, so the voyage from newcomer to trusted trader cannot be shortcut. A prism of verified jobs separates real contribution from cheap copies, and only sustained work yields the nectar of higher limits.
